reviews.t: I love the coconut scent and the color turns out a ...
reviews.x: I love the coconut scent and the color turns out a nice bronze, and not streaky.  I recommend using a soft/washable mitt over latex gloves. The color lasts for about 3 days.  I am middle age and have some sun spots so this helps cover them, and not turn the spots darker, as some self tanners do.

This is probably the closest thing (I've used) to having an airbrush tan. The color develops quickly and the scent is the most pleasant out of all the self tanners I've tried. It smells a little coco-nutty & like suntan lotion. I'm very fair, and I use the dark bronze formula. It gives me a golden brown tan. (No oompa loompa or cheeto orange!) It's very natural looking without being "too" dark. If I need to be "bikini worthy" dark, I just do another application. When I received m

reviews.t: Afordable and easy way to stay tan all year long
reviews.x: I have been using this product for about two months and honestly like it more than the other self tanner I was using prior that was double the price.  First off the smell is devine. Especially compared to previous self tanners I've used. Does not have a strong fake tan smell, and I also don't notice the smell lingering on my skin for extended periods of time.  The color of this product is great and never looks orange or gives me that too dark/red fake tan look I've experienced with other product

This is my 4th time puchasing this self tanner. I have used almost every brand out there and this is the only tanner I have ever bought a second bottle of. It applies beautifully and lasts a little over a week. It doesn't fade horribly like others ( just make sure to exfoliate a day before and moisturize daily). The scent is not bad. It will transfer to sheets so i advise wearing a long sleeve shirt and pants. The transfer does NOT stain, so just wash your sheet/clothes. Did not stain my toilet

reviews.t: Great product! Excellent customer service experience!
reviews.x: This is the best sunless tanner I have ever purchased. It was easy to apply and has a tint so you can see where you are applying. Initially there is a nice bronzing effect and nice, natural looking color, once the tan develops. There was no residual self tanning smell, just the yummy fragrance of the product.  My personal experience: I exfoliated using a dry scrub and loofah in the shower before drying off and applying the product using a mitt. I applied it lightly to my elbows, knees, and ankle

I'm really torn on this review. If I could give it 2.5 stars, I would. It does have a considerable pro or two, but it also is laden with a lot of items in the "cons" column. So first, the good stuff: SugarBaby delivers on its promise to provide a dark bronze tan. The color is deep and natural looking and develops quickly. Another unexpected pro with this product is that I found the "guide" to be a pretty color once it dried and settled, so if it was necessary to go out after tann

reviews.t: This self tanner has great color, a nice coconut scent and it is ...
reviews.x: This self tanner has great color, a nice coconut scent and it is buildable if you want a deeper tan!  I applied one layer, let it set overnight and washed it off in the morning. Then I applied another layer after showering to deepen the tan. I was really pleased with the results after using it!  The only con is that this has a lot of transfer compared to other self tanners I have used. The insides of my clothes were stained after using this. Love love love this tanner! stays on forever and its a beautiful color.

reviews.t: Best sunless tanner I have found and I have tried dang near all of them!
reviews.x: This is by far the BEST sunless tanner I have ever used.  I have purchased 3 bottles of this magic golden glow and I use it once a week.  Each time I use it I get so many complements on my tan.  HA!  It's fake but it looks real. Tips: -You MUST use the mitt - it also gives you an even coverage and it's very soft. -No matter how long I walk around naked in my room to let it dry, it still ends up rubbing off on clothing, it leaves a pinkish tint but washes out in the washer. -I usually sleep with

This is one of my most favorite self tanning lotions, I get compliments on my color all the time and I rave about this stuff. BUT if I can't depend on the product not to be damaged when it arrives I won't continue to buy it. This is the 2nd time I've had a bottle arrive damaged. I really don't understand why products like this aren't packaged better so that they don't explode from temperature changes. Which is all I can assume happened to it unless it's just a faulty bottle.  I'm seriously annoy

It’s very nice! I love it. Gives me a healthy, looking tan. It’s a foam so I like that, but halfway through using it it has stopped foaming. So now it is basically just liquid tan. But it still works just as good. Just a little messy. And throughout applying you need to wipe your hands off on a wet towel as much as you can. It will stain your hands QUICK.

Don't be fooled by this cute packaging!! I have used self tanners for years, this one that I received is OLD. It literally cones out green and eill stain you green! I only used it in a small portion of my arm to test it, thsnk goodness. C'mon people, sell us NEW products, not shelf worn stuff!
Works great with a nice dark tan. Best used with a lotion so no streaking occurs. I tried a few others but this works the best.
It's alright, not the best I've tried, still can't seem to find the perfect one that actually lasts long and looks great.

reviews.t: Love. Could tell I was darker after one application
reviews.x: Love. Could tell I was darker after one application. It does need to be applied daily or at least every other day.
Love this! Has a bit of a chemical smell, but color is very nice and lasts around 4-6 days.

I bought this because I couldn't find my usual favorite at Walmart.  It came quickly and the only issue I had with the packaging was that the bottle had leaked a little.  I got half way through the application and the pump broke so I swapped it out with my Nuetrogena self tanner pump top.  I pumped it a few times to get the Nuetrogena self tanner out of the pump and wow...what a difference in the colors of the two products.  Sugar Baby has an olive tone to it which is superb for self tanners so

reviews.t: Packaging of the product itself was a mess
reviews.x: I wanted to update this review. this product is a mess to try and use!!! I shake it until I feel it's mixed and you can feel the pressure build, but it only comes out as a liquid not a foam. I have previously loved using this product but the last two have been just like this. Probably will not order again and that is unfortunate because when working properly, it is the best I've ever used!!! A little disappointed in the package of this product this time!! Hopefully when I open it and clean it up

I was so excited to try this because i saw a video on YouTube about it. My tan turned out beautifully and i got a lot of compliments. However, during the first use the pump broke and now instead of the product being a mousse, it leaks EVERYWHERE! It is also hard to get the product rubbed into the skin to where oh doesn’t appear patchy. I would rather pay more for a better formula and bottle that doesn’t break.

reviews.t: This stuff is amazing! It goes on really well with no streaking
reviews.x: This stuff is amazing! It goes on really well with no streaking, actually smells good, and develops into a really natural tan. It looks like I spent the weekend in the sun without any of the damaging effects! One caveat: it does transfer some even after drying, but it washes out of cotton and cotton blends easily. This is a great product and absolutely a great value!

Very nice, does not streak - also does not smell, which is rare for self tanners, at least I find that. And it also arrived with a leak from the top (due to the way it had been packaged) and the seller worked very quickly to fix the issue. It does a great job tanning the skin evenly and quickly. I would recommend!

reviews.t: This self tanner blends so beautifully into your skin
reviews.x: This self tanner blends so beautifully into your skin! I love the beachy scent & cute packaging. Make sure you invest in those tanning mitts, They were invented for a reason! The results are even, not streaked. You have immediate color that deepens over the next few hours. The color lasts around 5 days for me.

The color is okay, the scent is okay, but the bottle stopped working after about 5 uses. The foam stopped coming out and it leaked everywhere! It would only come out as liquid and would squirt all over the place trying to pump it out. There’s probably half of a bottle left that’s unusable.

What a mess!!! Just unwrapped the "protective packaging" and the tanning mousse is everywhere! It leaked and is not even usable at this point, and the nozzle is cracked. I will NOT order again, and hope this will help others to not make rhe same mistake with this product. What a waste!

reviews.t: NICE WARM COLOR NO ORANGE NO BAD SMELL
reviews.x: I have tried so many other tanners. This has been the best I have ever tried. The color it gives me is a nice olive color, not orange. There is seriously no after smell like other tanners give. I keep ordering this over and over. I suggest to buy some tanning gloves to apply it with .

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the natural-looking bronze color and even application.
Many reviewers love the pleasant coconut/suntan-lotion scent and note the absence of a fake tan smell.
Several reviewers report the tan lasts well, from about three days to over a week.
Some reviewers complain about receiving damaged, old, or faulty product, including one that turned green.
A few reviewers mention issues with fading, longevity, or the product becoming messy/non-foaming.
